subject.title: fix(heartbeat): bound HEARTBEAT.md file read size

question: Should heartbeat preflight preserve the existing ability to read a symlinked `HEARTBEAT.md`, or intentionally adopt regular-file-only fail-closed behavior?
rationale: The central size bound is mechanical, but the selected helper also changes a shipped file-resolution behavior at a security and compatibility boundary, which should not be inferred from the bug-fix title alone.

options.title: Preserve symlink compatibility
options.body: Use a bounded read that retains the prior symlink-following behavior and limit this PR to preventing oversized buffering.

options.title: Adopt regular-file-only behavior
options.body: Approve symlink rejection explicitly and require focused upgrade coverage and user-facing documentation for the newly ignored setup.

recommendation.title: Preserve symlink compatibility
recommendation.body: Use a bounded read that retains the prior symlink-following behavior and limit this PR to preventing oversized buffering.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent merged work maintained heartbeat runtime and session behavior closest to this compatibility boundary.
